title: A New Practice for a New Reality
coreMove: Diagnose overload as undefined commitments and externalize each one into a place you will revisit.

exampleSpecs.domain: a public defender opening case files after a crowded arraignment morning
exampleSpecs.audience: a public defender carrying too many client promises at once
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a court deadline or client follow-up gets missed because every case feels equally urgent
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the defender stops treating the pressure as a character flaw and sees each worry as an open loop that needs a visible holding place before it can be judged

exampleSpecs.domain: two parents coordinating asthma medication, school forms, and a leaking sink on Sunday evening
exampleSpecs.audience: a parent who feels household work is everywhere and nowhere
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a child's health routine and school paperwork are protected without turning the evening into blame
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the conversation shifts from accusing someone of forgetting to asking what each loose item is, what needs to be true, and where the reminder will live

exampleSpecs.domain: a restaurant line cook newly responsible for prep before a festival weekend
exampleSpecs.audience: a first-time kitchen lead whose work now includes invisible coordination
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether missing produce orders and vague verbal requests cause service delays and food waste
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the cook sees that 'handle prep' failed because it was not a defined commitment with a next visible action, owner, and trusted reminder

exampleSpecs.domain: an air-traffic control strip board compared with a controller trying to remember every aircraft unaided
exampleSpecs.audience: a reader skeptical that writing things down changes anything
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the reader grasps that external systems reduce mental load without doing the thinking for you
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the example makes the point that trusted containers do not replace judgment; they keep memory from becoming the runway

exampleSpecs.domain: a museum registrar preparing loan paperwork while donor emails and shipping questions arrive
exampleSpecs.audience: an arts administrator handling precise work amid constant interruptions
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether insurance terms and shipping dates for a valuable artwork are handled cleanly instead of scattered across attention
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the registrar captures new inputs as 'stuff' to clarify rather than letting each arrival hijack the current checklist

exampleSpecs.domain: a rural veterinarian returning calls between farm visits with lab results, invoices, and medication questions in play
exampleSpecs.audience: a mobile professional whose commitments arrive away from a desk
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether animal care, client trust, and billing accuracy survive a day spent in motion
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the vet notices that fatigue comes less from the number of calls than from carrying unparked promises across locations
